content: {"promos": [{"title": "The Duke Returns", "start_block": "B012", "end_block": "B028", "hook": "A scout whispers, 'Six at the front,' while a fighter replies, 'Four more inside,' as they watch the cathedral.", "cliffhanger": "Royal guards lie unconscious on the steps as the cart driver tells the fighter, 'The road is clear.'", "why": "High tension and action immediately establish the threat to the wedding and the rescue mission.", "context_gap": "Strangers won't know the Duke is returning to reclaim his house or that the guards are being neutralized."}, {"title": "Reclaiming His House", "start_block": "B031", "end_block": "B058", "hook": "Alexander stares at his rugged reflection in a mirror, tracing a scar, and declares, 'They buried Alexander Ashwin three years ago. Today, he comes home.'", "cliffhanger": "Alexander vows, 'And I am bringing my wife home,' as his eyes burn with furious determination.", "why": "The reveal of the Duke's identity and his vow to rescue his wife creates a powerful emotional hook.", "context_gap": "Viewers need to know he is the exiled Duke and that his wife is in danger to understand the stakes."}, {"title": "March to War", "start_block": "B044", "end_block": "B058", "hook": "Alexander steps out of the barn doors in full ducal regalia, and a loyalist soldier drops to his knee, saying, 'Your Grace.'", "cliffhanger": "Alexander commands, 'Secure the chapel,' and vows, 'I am taking back my house,' as he marches forward.", "why": "The visual transformation into the Duke and the command to secure the chapel sets up a high-stakes confrontation.", "context_gap": "Audiences must understand he is shedding his disguise and that the chapel is the target."}], "moments": [{"start_block": "B020", "end_block": "B024", "kind": "hook", "description": "The cart driver lunges at a royal sentry, tackling him violently against the carriage wheel."}, {"start_block": "B026", "end_block": "B028", "kind": "cliffhanger", "description": "The loyalist fighter whispers, 'Sleep,' as the sentry goes limp in his sleeper hold."}, {"start_block": "B031", "end_block": "B032", "kind": "reveal", "description": "Alexander stares at his rugged reflection in a cracked mirror, tracing a scar."}, {"start_block": "B047", "end_block": "B048", "kind": "reveal", "description": "A loyalist soldier drops to his knee before Alexander, calling him 'Your Grace.'"}]}
